notes.method: Randomized paired built-binary launches under Xvfb, warm caches and isolated app profiles. Each timing case includes two warmups per build. The large fixture was a temporary copy of the showcase with 10000 extra files on the project filesystem.
notes.statDiagnostic: One strace run per build counted fixture-name stat syscalls only; baseline 10000, candidate 0. Trace timings were not used.
notes.fontDiagnostic: Removed font-face definitions as a diagnostic only; this would change math typography and was not retained.
notes.assetCompression: Compressed and uncompressed labels refer to Tauri embedded-asset compression; uncompressed build was not retained.
